protocol.selection: lowest validation BCE across the fixed 10 epochs
protocol.test_seal_note: Existing loader parses all splits for transaction and contract checks; test identities and row counts are checked, but test labels are not used by train_model or validator. Availability counts inspect label type/censor flags, not success values.
protocol.ranking: mean P(clear) on even sample indices selects; raw Bernoulli clear mean on odd indices evaluates; 5 selection and 5 evaluation trials per arm
protocol.confidence_intervals: 95% seed-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0; bounds are fragile with only 3 validation seeds

committed_manifests.source: dataset seed_complete markers, cross-checked against both checkpoint seed_ids

primary_trial_availability.note: Unknown and censored counts overlap; censored labels are not failures. Training and calibration use primary arms only.

timing_and_memory_notes: Fit elapsed_seconds includes loading three splits, normalization, training, validation selection and provenance hashing; isolated optimizer-only training time was not instrumented.
Models ran sequentially. RSS/private memory sampled each second via psutil; sampled peaks can miss brief transients. OS working-set high-water marks were also sampled.

Loader now streams read_dataset instead of retaining all splits and removes state only from auxiliary coverage/independent trials on retained rows. Primary trials, all auxiliary labels and transaction/contract validation remain unchanged.

coverage.validator_limitation: Existing validation CLI coverage section examines extended arms inside arms, not separate coverage_arms, so its zero coverage decisions is not the collected coverage count. Diagnostics below were computed separately without refitting or modifying reports.

train_and_validation_descriptive_only.intersection_basis: zero reference regret, with no excluded reference arms

coverage.interpretation: Fractional top1 near 0.1 measures the restricted pool's share of tied reference maxima, not failure to contain a best action. All validation reference arms tie. Reference maxima are noisy finite-sample proxies, not exhaustive legal-action oracles; no independent reference repetitions. Test reference outcomes remain unreported.

conclusion: Both validation verdicts are INCONCLUSIVE by design. Attention has lower observed validation Brier in this one fixed run, but both models have +0.4 percentage-point paired advantage versus anchor; only 8 informative decisions from 2 seeds provide no basis for architecture superiority or live-policy improvement. Test remains sealed.
